outcome.answer: Yes. The closest match is “A Concentration Bound for Two-Timescale Actor-Critic Algorithm” [1], which gives a high-probability bound on the actor error \(\|\theta_k-\theta^*\|\) for all sufficiently late iterations and says the actor eventually enters a safe region and remains there with high probability [1]. The stated bound depends on the iteration, initial time, and probability parameters [1].
